newsitem.title: UK: Hong Kong stocks in London pulled up by HK bank.
newsitem.headline: Hong Kong stocks in London pulled up by HK bank.

text.p: Hong Kong shares trading in London were mostly higher in quiet trade on Thursday with activity centred around HongKong Bank and Cathay Pacific, dealers said.
"HongKong Bank has led the way and everything else has been marked up in sympathy," said one senior trader.
The Hang Seng London Reference Index was up 52.82 points at 15,180.84 by 1448 GMT and dealers predicted the Hong Kong market would push higher again on Friday.

"The July futures closed at a 20-point premium so we're looking for the market to go better," one said. June index futures expired earlier today. In Hong Kong on Thursday the Hang Seng climbed 105 points or 0.73 percent.
Among shares trading in London HSBC set the generally higher tone. The stock was trading at HK$233.85 compared with a close of HK$232.00 in Hong Kong.
Cathay Pacific was another feature. The shares climbed to HK$15.95 from HK$15.65.
